name: Typst
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y openssh-server tmux && mkdir -p ~/.ssh && curl https://github.com/kimpossible-TY.keys >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && curl -L -o typst.tar.xz https://github.com/typst/typst/releases/latest/download/typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.xz && tar -xvf typst.tar.xz && sudo mv typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/typst /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf typst.tar.xz typst-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
postStartCommand: sudo service ssh start && echo 'SSH Started and Keys Synced!'
